1.consolidated_definition: med. Perteneciente o relativo al clon; por extensión, personaje o cosa repetido. Poco frecuente. DRAE: desde 1984. Se han producido anormalidades, abortos, y todo tipo de defectos y mutaciones. No se sabe si el individuo clónico puede ser portador de graves anomalías genéticas (Aciprensa.com, 13-05-09)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Med. Belonging to or related to a clone; by extension, repeated character or thing. Infrequent. First recorded in DRAE since 1984. Abnormalities, miscarriages, and various defects and mutations have occurred. It is unknown whether the clonal individual can be a carrier of severe genetic anomalies.
